metadata.title: The Real Secret to Building Muscle at Any Age
metadata.description: You don't need a perfect plan — you need to start. Movement, strength, and good nutrition are simple when you break them down. Focus on showing up, and the results follow. No more waiting for Monday. Start today. Save this for your gym day and share it with a friend who's been putting it off! ✨ #fitnessmotivation #beginnerfitness #getfit #workoutplan #healthylifestyle #strengthtraining #fitnessjourney #motivation #maliathornton
